battleCard.pitch: Migration finishes and nothing improves, because the operating model never changed. We design the platform team, the funding model, and the guardrails so cloud actually reduces cost and cycle time instead of just relocating the problem.

discoveryQuestions: Who owns the platform today — a funded team or borrowed people?
How long does an application team wait for a new environment?

How many of your guardrails are automated versus enforced by review boards?

qualifyIn: Post-migration estate that hasn't delivered promised savings
Application teams waiting on infrastructure
Mid-market organisations wanting self-sufficiency
Leadership willing to fund a small permanent platform team
qualifyOut: Pre-migration clients with no cloud footprint yet
Organisations committed to full MSP outsourcing indefinitely

faq.q: We just finished migrating — why do we need this now?
faq.a: That's exactly when the gap shows. The estate moved but the operating model didn't, which is why costs stay flat and delivery doesn't speed up.

faq.q: We can't fund a dedicated platform team.
faq.a: Most mid-market clients can't fund a large one — we size it for what's realistic, typically 4–6 people, and automate the rest.

objectionHandling.objection: Our MSP already handles operations.
objectionHandling.response: Operations and platform engineering are different disciplines. An MSP keeps the lights on; a platform team makes your application teams faster. We're happy to design a model where the MSP stays.

objectionHandling.objection: We already have a cloud team.
objectionHandling.response: The question isn't whether the team exists — it's whether they're funded, mandated, and measured correctly. Most teams we see are doing ops, not platform engineering.

whyWeWin: Sized for what organisations actually fund — not aspirational blueprints
Combines organisational design with technology guardrails
Reference engagement with published outcomes
Pairs naturally with FinOps, Cloud Strategy, and IT for the Future

competitiveCounters.counter: They design a model sized for an enterprise the client isn't. Ours is sized for what mid-market will actually fund and staff.

competitiveCounters.counter: Their commercial model depends on the client not becoming self-sufficient. Ours transfers the capability.
competitiveCounters.trapQuestion: What does your revenue look like once the client runs the platform themselves?

faq.q: How is this different from FinOps?
faq.a: FinOps governs cloud infrastructure spend (compute, storage, network). TokenOps governs GenAI consumption (tokens, API calls, model inference). Different unit metrics, different optimisation levers, different stakeholders.

faq.q: We only use one AI provider.
faq.a: Even single-provider estates benefit from unit economics, consumption governance, and model selection optimisation. Most clients we see have more GenAI usage than they realise.

objectionHandling.objection: Our FinOps team can handle this.
objectionHandling.response: FinOps teams are excellent at cloud cost management. Token economics are fundamentally different — per-call pricing, model version dependencies, prompt length impact. We extend their capability, not replace it.

objectionHandling.objection: GenAI spend isn't material yet.
objectionHandling.response: That's the best time to set up governance — before it grows. Organisations that wait until GenAI is 10% of their cloud bill find governance 5x harder to retrofit.

objectionHandling.objection: Can't we just use the provider's cost dashboard?
objectionHandling.response: Provider dashboards show consumption. They don't show unit economics per use case, allocation to business functions, or the governance framework for who can spend what.

whyWeWin: First-mover advantage — TokenOps is a distinct offering, not a FinOps afterthought
Sibling to FinOps Excellence — same methodology, different unit metrics
Combines AI/ML understanding with cost governance discipline
Jump Start methodology — 6-week fixed scope, fixed price

competitiveCounters.counter: Tools show you the number. We build the operating model, unit economics, and governance around it.
competitiveCounters.trapQuestion: Can your tool calculate the cost per business transaction flowing through GenAI — or just the total API spend?
